name: Miyakoji Rinka
source:
[b]A Demon Slayer・Exorcist Ninja[/b]

Age: 19 years old
Height: Slightly tall
Bust: Large

Normally, she is a college student, but this might be a disguise used to conceal herself.

The true identity of her is an Exorcist Ninja named Rin.
Her supernatural ability is used for exorcism, slaying the demons lurking in the world of darkness.

Once, when she was hanging by a thread from a demon attack, she was saved by [url=/c166953]the protagonist[/url].
From that moment, she secretly has a crush on him, but due to her serious personality, she finds it difficult to express her feelings.

*Heroine of Vol.2

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1364175/]Getchu[/url]]
